contexts.text: The pillars were... filleted with silver, and the hooks were of silver () = rational truths deriving their origin immediately from scientifics.
Their hooks of gold () = the methods of conjunction by means of good. Hooks = methods of conjunction. Hooks have this signification from their form. AC 9691.
The hooks of the pillars and their fillets of silver () = the methods of conjunction by means of truth.
Like a chain when the hook is removed.
One depends on the other, as a chain upon its links.
